newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 27.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- There will be no devaluation of the CFA franc after the advent in 1999 of a single European currency, France's economy minister says after the annual meeting of Africa's CFA franc zone ministers in Paris.
- Cooking gas bottles are in short supply in Ivory Coast

- An announcement from the government and its privatisation committee says that the deadline for offers for the Abidjan (Vridi) and San Pedro freight terminals owned by state agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie has been put back from September 30 to November 18.
